decisions.reason: The combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot extends the firm's core precast automation know-how, and its in-house R&D lets it interpret early results and refine the product.
The de-shuttering robot sits close to the firm's established formwork and control expertise, so it can absorb market feedback and improve the robot.
The profile storage robot complements the firm's shuttering systems and builds on existing plant-planning knowledge, making it easy to integrate and develop further.
The automatic shuttering robot builds directly on the firm's core competence and fits its strategy of automated precast production, supported by its own R&D.
